component_graph.raw_cluster_id_use: opaque provenance only; never used for ranking, ties, or semantic output hashes

rules.background: all border-touching components are retained as provisional BG; no foreground component may overwrite them in v4
rules.lv_myo: score candidate non-border MYO component plus one or more non-border LV components using enclosure boundary support and relative area
rules.rv: after a MYO/LV hypothesis wins, choose the strongest non-border component adjacent to MYO; low-score or tied RV remains VOID
rules.conflicts: rank complete LV/MYO hypotheses before assignments; retain only labels stable among near-optimal hypotheses

intensity_policy.reason: v4 validates and binds central_image but does not use intensity until a separately calibrated version

orientation_policy.reason: shared geometry does not establish a common short-axis direction

void_policy.validity_encoding: boolean; true iff semantic encoding is not VOID
